content: Manchester City's Mateo Kovacic says the club "count on me" despite the midfielder being linked with a move away this summer.

zh.title: 曼城看重我 尽管转会传闻 - 科瓦契奇
zh.summary: 曼城中场球员马特奥·科瓦契奇在面临夏季离队传闻的情况下，公开表示俱乐部"看重我"。这一声明既回应了转会传闻，也重申了他对曼城的承诺。

title: Who am I? Guess Premier League star No 15
summary: Readers attempt to identify a Premier League player through a guessing game format, marked as "Premier League star No 15." The interactive feature engages fans in a player identification challenge.
content: Work out the identity of today's player in as few attempts as possible.

zh.title: 我是谁？猜测英超球星第15号
zh.summary: 读者通过猜谜游戏尝试识别英超球员，标记为"英超球星第15号"。这个互动功能让球迷参与球员识别挑战。

title: A youngster to watch at each Premier League club this season
summary: As the Premier League prepares to return later in the month, BBC Sport highlights 20 rising prospects—one from each club—expected to break through this season. The feature showcases emerging talent positioned for breakthrough campaigns.
content: The Premier League returns later this month and we have picked out 20 prospects - one from each club - who will be looking to make their mark and enjoy a breakthrough season.

zh.title: 本赛季英超各俱乐部值得关注的年轻球员
zh.summary: 随着英超联赛准备在本月晚些时候回归，BBC体育部门重点介绍了20位上升中的新星——每家俱乐部各一位——预计将在本赛季突破。该功能展示了有望实现突破性职业生涯的新兴人才。

title: The summer that changed Welsh football
summary: Ten years after Euro 2016, key Welsh football figures recount how that summer tournament transformed the sport in Wales. The retrospective examines the lasting legacy and impact of that championship run.
content: A decade on from Euro 2016, key figures tell BBC Sport Wales the inside story of the summer that changed Welsh football forever.

zh.title: 改变威尔士足球的那个夏天
zh.summary: 欧洲杯2016十年后，关键的威尔士足球人物讲述了那个夏天的锦标赛如何改变了威尔士足球运动。这部回顾性文章审视了那次锦标赛的长期遗产和影响。
